QUOTE: !MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY → #define to calloc / free (platform.h:163-167)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY is not set (the default), mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros defined directly as calloc and free. That is the "no indirection in a default build" fact.
